fusions.name: Wrought Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps a heavy boot, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and leaving each one 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Final Clang
fusions.desc: A finishing kick that deals 22 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Unbending Advance
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage, up to 4 blows, for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 8%. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Marching Greaves
fusions.desc: Conjures iron greaves: every hit you take is 1 lower, your armour rises by 8%, you move 4% faster, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
